title: US equity-index cash-close intraday momentum transfer
user_boundary: The repository integrity patch is complete and the user instructed the continuous Live-derived Optimization research to resume. A genuinely new research clue may open one serial Lab unit, but it grants no Live replacement, deployment or promotion authority.

research_height.transfer_path: A literature-fixed cash-session directional field must survive two symbols, four pre-latest blocks, doubled spread and a signal-unseen latest veto before one indivisible additive Optimization seed can exist.

central_question: Does the sign of each U.S. equity index's return from the previous full cash-session close to 15:30 ET predict a profitable same-direction 15:30..16:00 ET move after doubled FPMarkets spread cost, broadly enough across US30 and US100 to justify one later paired Optimization seed?
economic_hypothesis: The externally fixed continuation rule should produce positive and sufficiently efficient stressed economics in the initial block, all three confirmation blocks, both symbols and both predictor directions, with bounded concentration and no material latest-period reversal. Otherwise the exact mechanism creates no seed.

why_now.optimization_state: The 59-dimensional formula surface and both exact interaction clues are closed. The fixed paired-month development candidate remains attributable but has no independent ready formula or allocation successor.
why_now.independent_source: Published intraday-momentum research fixes a causal time boundary and direction before this repository's final-half-hour outcomes are opened. This is not a neighbor of the closed internal formula grid.
why_now.information_value: The rule can create two fixed same-day starts on each eligible U.S. cash session, directly addressing independent entry supply without changing existing component formulas, weights, risk or exits.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one indivisible US30+US100 cash-close continuation information seed. Only a later separately owned Optimization proxy may test shared-account interaction with the fixed candidate.
why_now.decision_if_false: Close this exact cash-close continuation mechanism with no time, direction, threshold, symbol, magnitude, volatility or session rescue.

distinction_from_closed_work.current_return_component: The existing US30 Return component evaluates at fixed 16:00 server time, uses a four-completed-H1 normalized negative impulse, enters LONG as reversion and holds six H1 bars. Unit 108 uses the previous New York cash close to 15:30 ET, continuation, both US30 and US100, and a 30-minute close.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_028_session_reopen: Unit 028 studied a bounded US100 CFD session-reopen discontinuity and one-hour response. Unit 108 uses the regular U.S. cash close, previous full-session price path and no reopen gap.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_086_late_session_dislocation: Unit 086 conditioned on native signal-deficit days and a US30-US100 relative dislocation in the 19:00..23:00 region. Unit 108 is unconditional, single-symbol in its predictor and paired only at the decision bundle.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_093_cross_convergence: Unit 093 used a thresholded US100-US30 relative residual and a multi-leg convergence sleeve. Unit 108 has no peer price in either symbol's signal, no z-score and no convergence direction.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_103_h1_lead_lag: Unit 103 used the completed leader H1 sign for the follower's next hour across all clocks. Unit 108 uses each symbol's own full-session cumulative sign at one literature-fixed cash boundary.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_107_formula_interactions: Unit 107 attributed two exact internal component-formula interactions. Unit 108 changes none of those formulas and consumes no candidate ledger or portfolio outcome.

fixed_bundle.eligible_session: Both symbols must each contain the exact complete 390 M1 rows from 09:30 through 15:59 ET. The immediately preceding paired complete session must be 1..4 calendar days earlier.
fixed_bundle.predictor: Current 15:30 open midpoint / prior paired-session 15:59 close midpoint - 1 for that symbol.
fixed_bundle.direction: Continuation only: BUY positive, SELL negative. No direction selection or reversion book.
fixed_bundle.entry: Current 15:30 ET M1 open bid/ask proxy.
fixed_bundle.exit: Current 15:59 ET M1 close bid/ask proxy, representing the 16:00 boundary.

fixed_cost_proxy.gross: Midpoint-to-midpoint direction P/L times contract size and volume.
fixed_cost_proxy.observed: Gross minus one half of the entry-plus-exit full-spread burden; exact executable bid/ask identity is required.
fixed_cost_proxy.stressed: Gross minus the full entry-plus-exit spread burden; this doubled-cost measure is binding.
fixed_cost_proxy.drawdown: Combined closes sorted by exit epoch, symbol and entry epoch; closed-balance drawdown only. Proxy drawdown is selection information and cannot prove MT5 equity DD.
fixed_cost_proxy.commission_swap_financing: Zero for this fixed 30-minute proxy. Native deal economics remain mandatory only if a later Optimization campaign is separately declared.

p1: combined net > 0, profit factor >= 1.05 and net/drawdown >= 1.25
p2_p4_confirmation: P2, P3 and P4 combined nets separately > 0
both pooled symbol nets and both pooled predictor-side nets > 0
p1_p4_prelatest: largest symbol <= 75% of summed positive symbol net
top five positive paired days <= 40% of total positive-day profit
latest_and_full: practical P5 floor = -0.25 * positive P1-P4 average stressed USD per paired day * P5 paired days
full P1-P5 net > 0 and profit factor >= 1.05
fixed_economic_gates.nominal_pass: Every non-marginal gate plus nominal DD and nominal P5 pass.
fixed_economic_gates.practical_pass: Every non-marginal gate plus practical DD and practical P5 pass; exact nominal misses remain disclosed.
fixed_economic_gates.seed: At most one exact FIXED_US30_US100_CASH_CLOSE_INTRADAY_MOMENTUM_BUNDLE. No single symbol or altered rule can survive.

fixed_verdict_rules.nonconfirmation: VALID_NO_CASH_CLOSE_INTRADAY_MOMENTUM_AFTER_COST_NO_SEED when initial or pooled pre-latest core economics are nonpositive after valid doubled costs.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_CASH_CLOSE_INTRADAY_MOMENTUM_NO_SEED when some positive economics exist but the complete robustness contract does not pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any immutable-input, schema, calendar, bid/ask identity, serialization, design or implementation fault is CORRECTION_REQUIRED_NO_ECONOMIC_VERDICT and may be corrected without numeric retry cap while this economic contract remains unchanged.
